meta.note: The read path's first verb. One swipe pairs the default session and self-grants an unlock; every `get` step then rides that grant, so no step after the first needs a phone. The account is the burner (DESIGN.md §6): its published keys mean the recorded stdout carries the fabricated logins in the clear, deliberately, and the keys are retired after the sitting. Covers a whole login, a raw field, plain and protected custom fields, a field by id, labels, a multi-line note, a miss, vault-by-name, org-name and vault-by-id scoping, and a deleted login returned rather than hidden.
